world_model_delta: Memory intensity decays at 10% per turn for standard memories if faction takes no action on the remembered island. High-importance memories decay at 5% per turn. Decayed memories remain in record but their pathfinding weight reduces proportionally.
validator_question: Does memory decay create erratic pathfinding behavior at low intensity?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — pathfinding weight tapers smoothly; no erratic behavior
